summary: v20 verification of GökyüzüWebSpam — 5 new features across payments, maintenance, geo, and security. Backend pytest: 6/6 PASS (Havale notify→pending→inbox→approve chain, reject flow with reason recording, auto-cleanup default cfg enabled/90d/archive/day_of_month=1, POST persist + GET readback, run-now archive execution with total counter, geo/blocked-heatmap items with country/name/count/lat/lon). Frontend playwright e2e: all 5 flows working — Landing GeoBlockedHeatmap SVG renders, Havale flow create→IBAN card→'Havale Yaptım · Bildir' opens form→submit→'Bildirim Gönderildi' success card visible, /panel/payments-admin loads with 4 tabs (pending/inbox/all/refresh) and pending-list container, /panel/maintenance shows 'Otomatik Aylık Temizlik' card with 'Ayarları Kaydet' + 'Şimdi Çalıştır' buttons, /panel/security default tab='dashboard' with TrustDashboard rendering trust-score value + Modül Durumları grid (9/11 active) + Kritik Bulgu tile + Reputation Snapshot + embedded modules.

issues: Trust Score renders as 0 (Kritik) because 8 exploit findings deduct heavily from finalScore. Numerically correct given data, but for a fresh install/demo the score may feel harsh. Consider softer weight or clamp/floor when findings are seeded test data.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.py — havale/notify correctly persists user_transaction_ref/user_sender_name/user_note, inserts inbox notification with read=false. approve() and reject() both bulk-clear related inbox notifications via update_many — good cross-collection consistency.
routes/payments.py admin/pending groups awaiting_transfer + notified_by_user and returns notified_count separately so UI can badge the tab count. Clean contract.

routes/maintenance.py — _run_auto_cleanup_once uses idempotent update with {archived: {$ne: True}} guard so re-runs don't double-count. Archive is a soft flag ($set archived:true, archived_at) not a delete — matches user request.

routes/maintenance.py auto-cleanup email report is wrapped in try/except so mail failure doesn't crash the cron. Good defensive design. However last_run_at/last_archived is updated via db.settings but the _key filter uses {_key:auto_cleanup} while the read side uses same key — consistent, ok.

routes/maintenance.py geo/blocked-heatmap aggregates BOTH db.lists (blacklist ip) AND db.threat_iocs — same IP counted twice if it exists in both. Depending on intent this is either double-count or double-weight; consider dedup by IP if concerned. Currently returns 3 countries US/CN/GB per agent notes.
Landing.js Havale notify UX is clean: success card replaces form (havale-notified testid), 8s toast, error path handled. Bank IBAN + TRF reference shown before notify.
PaymentsAdmin.js has good testids (pa-refresh, pa-tab-{k}, pa-pending-list, pa-approve-{oid}, pa-reject-{oid}, pa-all-table). Solid for future regression.
Security.js TrustDashboard is set as default tab and computes finalScore from modules + findings. finalScore formula could dip to 0 with only a handful of critical findings — see design_issues.

server.py _monthly_auto_cleanup_task background loop runs every hour and only fires on exact day_of_month+hour_utc match — acceptable, but if server restarts within that hour AFTER the trigger already ran, an idempotency guard on last_run_at date would prevent double-run. Currently relies on process staying up for the hour.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 v20 flows — Landing Heatmap render, Havale notify→success card, Payments-Admin 4 tabs+refresh+pending list, Maintenance AutoCleanup card+buttons, Security Dashboard default with trust-score+modules grid)
